newsitem.title: BULGARIA: DEMAND EASES ON BULGARIA MONEY MARKET, RATES FLAT.
newsitem.headline: DEMAND EASES ON BULGARIA MONEY MARKET, RATES FLAT.

text.p: Demand for Bulgarian interbank deposits fell from Wednesday, with depo rates unchanged in light volumes, dealers said.
"Demand for funds is very low because banks have high free lev liquidity," said a dealer.
Interbank overnight lev depo rates stood at 1.50-1.75 percent annually, flat from Wednesday. Spot week lev rates were also unchanged at 2.5-3.0 percent annually.
The average annual interbank deposit rate was 2.26 percent on Wednesday, up from 1.79 percent on Tuesday, a central bank official said.
Dealers said on Thursday the central bank will raise its main lev interest rate to 5.59 percent annually from 5.50 percent, effective Monday. -- Dessislava Popova, Sofia Newsroom +359-2 91188
